paragraphs: Yosef ben Elim of Sepphoris: Rabbi Yose said, ‘An incident concerning Yosef ben Ilim, who became disqualified; they appointed another in his place. His fellow priests did not allow him to be either high priest or ordinary priest’: Horayot 12b. But Yoma 12b, end, has: ‘An incident concerning Yosef ben Elim: a disqualification occurred in the high priest, and they appointed him in his place.’ So too Jerusalem Talmud there, 1:1, and Horayot 3:3. Tosafot likewise cites the Tosefta. Megillah 9b: ‘An incident concerning Rabbi Yosef ben Ilim, in whom a disqualification occurred in the high priest, and they appointed him in his place.’ The word Rabbi and the word ‘in him’ are scribal errors.
